objective.description: Hierarchical Coto-anchored regression: Stage A τ(298.15 K) on Coto tie-lines (isoactivity pre-fit + direct flash-composition polish); Stage B shared temperature slopes b on multi-T literature (per-dataset nuisance offsets absorb species lumping; only b transfers). Weights 1/u(x)², u floored at 0.003.

notes: fahim2005: experimental K_MONO trend sign 1, model 1 → PASS
fandary2006: experimental K_MONO trend sign 1, model 1 → PASS
aljimaz2006: experimental K_MONO trend sign 1, model 1 → PASS
Model NOT admitted — application fails closed (Temperature-Dependent LLE Model — DEVELOPMENT GAP).

boundedAssumptions: DI/POLY binary τ slopes bij ≡ 0 (no multi-temperature polyaromatic data) — approved bounded assumption; off-298.15 K results carry POLYAROMATIC_TEMPERATURE_ASSUMPTION and are Pending Validation.
Temperature slopes for SAT/MONO/NMP pairs transferred from C12–C17 alkane + C9–C11 alkylbenzene literature via per-dataset nuisance offsets; the offsets themselves are NOT part of the governed model.
